description: Seeded archive entries shown beneath the normal and eccentric spell generators. Browser-created entries are stored locally and merged with these immutable samples.

normal.title: Bear Bolt
normal.materialComponent: A tuft of bear fur wrapped around a smooth sling stone.
normal.target: One creature, object, or occupied 10-ft. square
normal.duration: Instantaneous; the summoned bear exists only during launch and impact

composition.summonedCreature: A Huge brown bear formed from temporary conjured flesh, fur, bone, blood, and momentum.
composition.substance: Real physical matter for the duration of transit and impact; not force, energy, illusion, or elemental material.
composition.sentience: The bear has no independent turn, allegiance, or continuing existence. It appears already committed to the projectile path.
composition.disposition: Unaligned and uncontrolled beyond the selected trajectory. It is neither friendly nor hostile because it cannot act independently.

effect.summary: You summon a Huge bear already moving at extraordinary speed and launch it along a straight trajectory toward the target. The bear strikes as a dense physical projectile, then disappears immediately after resolving all impact effects.
effect.primaryDamage: 1d8 bludgeoning damage per caster level, maximum 15d8.
effect.sizeImpactDamage: Add 4d8 bludgeoning damage for the Huge summoned mass.
effect.minimumDamage: At caster level 9th, Bear Bolt deals 13d8 damage before situational modifiers.
effect.maximumDamage: At caster level 15th or higher, Bear Bolt deals 19d8 damage.
effect.damageType: Bludgeoning; entirely physical and not subject to elemental resistance.
effect.critical: The spell does not threaten a critical hit unless an optional ranged spell attack variant is used.
effect.objectDamage: Apply hardness normally. Bear Bolt deals full damage to objects and structures.
effect.secondaryCollision: If the primary target is Large or smaller and fails its Reflex save, it is pushed 10 ft. directly away from the caster. If it collides with a solid surface or another creature, both take 2d6 additional bludgeoning damage. A struck secondary creature may attempt a Reflex save for half this collision damage.
effect.knockdown: A creature of Huge size or smaller that fails its Reflex save must succeed on a Strength or Balance check against the spell save DC or fall prone.
effect.trajectory: The bear travels in a straight line. Intervening barriers are struck first. Creatures do not provide cover unless they fully occupy the trajectory.
effect.missOrEmptySquare: When aimed at an occupied square rather than a creature, resolve the spell as a 10-ft.-square impact. Creatures in the square receive the normal Reflex save.

levelScaling.casterLevels1to8: Bear Bolt is normally unavailable before caster level 9th. Scrolls or exceptional early access use 1d8 per caster level plus 4d8 size damage.
levelScaling.casterLevels16plus: Damage remains capped at 19d8, but increase push distance to 20 ft. at caster level 18th.
levelScaling.metamagic: Enlarge Spell increases range normally. Widen Spell has no effect. Empower and Maximize affect only rolled damage, not push distance.

balanceNotes: Bear Bolt is intentionally comparable to a single-target fifth-level damage spell with strong object interaction and limited forced movement.
The Huge bear is a one-shot summoned projectile, not a creature that remains to attack, flank, block movement, or receive commands.
Because the damage is physical and ignores elemental resistance, Reflex half, normal hardness, and the straight-line interception rule are important limitations.

eccentric.title: Professor Wobblewick's Regrettably Literal Bear Bolt
eccentric.creator: Professor Wobblewick
eccentric.requiredNonsense: A small wooden sign reading BEAR, one spoonful of honey, and a sincere but poorly timed apology.
eccentric.manifestation: A Huge bear appears with the expression of someone who was not consulted, is launched bodily toward the selected target, strikes with a tremendous physical impact, vanishes, and leaves behind one perfectly ordinary paw print in an impossible location.
eccentric.mechanicalPosture: Use the archived normal Bear Bolt statistics. The eccentric version adds no damage. After impact, roll 1d6: on a 1, every witness remembers the bear wearing a tiny hat; on a 2, the caster smells of wet fur for one hour; on a 3, the target hears distant disappointed growling; on a 4-6, no additional effect occurs.
eccentric.sideEffect: The caster must say 'This is probably fine' during the somatic component or the bear arrives facing backward. A backward-facing bear still deals normal damage.
eccentric.rumoredOrigin: Professor Wobblewick reportedly intended to create a lightning bolt that frightened bears. His notation reversed the subject and object of the sentence.
eccentric.gmUse: A humorous signature spell, eccentric scroll, wizard-duel surprise, or memorable reward that remains mechanically tied to the normalized version.
